key_observations_html:
• Platform competition is increasingly distribution-led: partnership depth and channel reach are becoming stronger share drivers than technical differentiation alone. Related: Standard Chartered brings spot crypto trading to Dubai FX platform (CoinDesk).
  • Scale tends to reinforce itself: once platforms establish issuer and liquidity depth, they often capture a disproportionate share of incremental distributed value. Related: Mantle adds Paxos’ USDG stablecoin, joins Global Dollar Network (CoinTelegraph).
  • Custody and issuance integrations are moving rankings first: Stacks that win issuer workflow and distribution partnerships tend to climb platform rank ahead of category-level RWA totals. Related: Catastrophe bonds may join tokenization rush, with plans for test issuance in 2027 (CoinDesk).
